name: state
meaning: 0 roosting (not drawn), 1 flying at Ralph, 2 circling him, 3 flying home. Written only by Bat_SetState; drives the table at 0x495d4d and gates the draw in Bat_Render.

name: takeoffFrames
meaning: Consecutive Update frames on which Ralph was within 800 units AND the was-drawn latch at +0x78 was clear; at 2 the bat takes off. It is only an off-camera count after the bat has been drawn at least once. Zeroed when Ralph leaves and by SetState(0).

name: spinSpeed
meaning: Signed angular speed (4096 per turn, per second) while circling; drives both the orbit angle +0x90 and rot.y. Randomised 0x500..0x780 and negated on a Rand_Bounded(2) coin flip when state 2 begins.

name: unk68
meaning: Written 0 by Bat_SetState case 2 (0x496087) and never read. An exhaustive scan of every [reg + 0xNN] in 0x495900-0x496121 finds this as the only reference - a leftover field, most likely a removed timer.

name: hoverHeight
meaning: How far above Ralph the bat aims (the vertical axis points down, so it is subtracted). Rand_Range(0x80,0xd4) at load, re-rolled to Rand_Range(0x55,0xff) on every frame of circling.

name: approachRadius
meaning: Horizontal distance at which the approach turns into circling; Rand_Range(0x5a,0x96) = 90..150 when state 1 begins. Compared unsigned (jae) against Vec3s_DistXZ.

name: circleTimeMs
meaning: Milliseconds left to circle Ralph, counted down by g_dtMs; at < 0 the bat flies home. Rand_Range(0x1482,0x222e) = 5250..8750 ms when state 2 begins.

name: wasDrawnLastRender
meaning: Bat_Render latches inst.flags bit 0 here and Update clears it at the end of every frame. inst.flags bit 0 is written only inside the draw path (Instance_UpdateVisibility 0x55cae3), and Bat_Render skips ScnBody_Render entirely while state==0, so for a never-flown bat this is always 0.

name: targetPos
meaning: The point the bat aims at: Ralph's position copied each frame (6-byte copy from g_pWolf+0xc) with the vertical raised by hoverHeight.

name: toTarget
meaning: targetPos - pos, computed while approaching (three movsx word subtractions at 0x495a62-0x495aa9); normalised to 350 u/s by imul 0x15e / idiv and integrated by Vec3s_ScaleByDt.

name: homePos
meaning: Where the bat hangs: its designer-placed position captured at load, restored by Bat_SetState(0) through vtable +0x1c.

name: orbitRot
meaning: Euler angles fed to Mat34s_FromEulerScaled 0x55ca73 to spin orbitOffset around Ralph; only the middle element +0x90 ever changes, by spinSpeed*g_dt>>12. All three are zeroed when state 2 begins.

name: orbitOffset
meaning: Vector from Ralph to the bat at the moment circling started (pos copied in, then the target words subtracted in place); rotated by orbitRot each frame with Mat34s_TransformVec3i and re-added to the target to give the new horizontal position.

name: soundHandle
meaning: Handle of the looping wing-flap voice (sample 0xfe). SetState stops it before every transition and stores the new handle in states 1 and 2 - but each Sound_Play is guarded by Sound_IsSampleIdPlaying(0xfe) 0x549425, so only one bat in a level holds the voice and the others fly silently.
